extraction_notes: SS34 is included in the SS32-SS34 curve group in Fig. 3 and the SS32-SS36 curve group in Fig. 4.
The plotted curve points are manual digitizations from the supplied figures and preserve the displayed axis scales; they are typical characteristics, not guaranteed limits.

Maximum ratings on p. 1 for SS34: VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A, IFSM = 80 A, storage and junction temperature = -55 to +150 degC, RthetaJA = 80 degC/W, and RthetaJL = 20 degC/W.
The p. 2 electrical characteristics table also gives IR2 = 50 mA at VR = VDC and Ta = 100 degC for SS34; the required reverse_current field records the 25 degC IR1 maximum.
The datasheet publishes no reverse recovery time, breakdown voltage, or breakdown-current specification for SS34.
